Here's a rare opportunity to score a powerful gaming PC at a solid price. For Black Friday, Walmart has marked down the HyperX Omen GeForce RTX 5080 gaming PC to just $2,699.99 with free shipping after a $730 instant discount. This is the least expensive RTX 5080 desktop computer that I've seen in months and is, so far, the best 4K-ready gaming PC deal I've seen so far for Black Friday. I wouldn't be surprised if it sells out before November 27.

HyperX Omen RTX 5080 Gaming PC for $2,700

The HyperX Omen gaming PC is equipped with an Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus CPU, GeForce RTX 5080 16GB GPU, 16GB of DDR5-5600MHz RAM, and a 1TB SSD. The Core Ultra 7 270K Plus is a recently released (March 2026) Arrow Lake Refresh LGA 1851 processor with 24-cores and a max turbo frequency of 5.5GHz. This is one of Intel's top performers for gaming, productivity, and AI

The GeForce RTX 5080 GPU will run any game in 4K

Performance-wise, the RTX 5080 is no slouch. It's one of the fastest cards on the market, bested only by the $2,000 (retail) RTX 5090 and the discontinued $1,600 (retail) RTX 4090. You'll be able to play latest, most demanding games in 4K resolution at high settings and ray tracing enabled. The DLSS 4.5 update has further optimized multi-frame gen and upscaling so you can push really high framerates even in 4K. More games are supporting this feature, including Doom: The Dark Ages, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, Battlefield 6, Death Stranding 2, and Crimson Desert. Check out our Nvidia GeForce RTX 5080 FE review for our hands-on impressions.
